name: Fresh Catfish
description: Farm-raised fresh catfish, carefully handled and delivered same-day. Ideal for grilling, pepper soup, and local delicacies. Rich in protein and omega-3 fatty acids.

name: Tilapia Fish
description: Premium quality tilapia raised in clean, well-managed ponds. Mild flavour and firm flesh — perfect for frying, grilling, or stew.

name: Broiler Chicken
description: Healthy, well-fed broiler chickens raised in hygienic conditions. Full-bodied and flavourful — great for every kitchen occasion.

name: Fresh Eggs (Crate)
description: Farm-fresh eggs from free-range layers. Packed in crates of 30. Rich yolk, strong shell, and excellent nutritional value.

name: Pork (Live Weight)
description: Healthy, well-nourished pigs raised on clean feed in a managed environment. Available for purchase live or processed on request.

name: Pork Cuts
description: Fresh pork cuts processed hygienically at our farm. Available in various portions — ribs, loin, belly, and more. Order ahead for best availability.

name: Black Soldier Fly Larvae
description: High-protein black soldier fly larvae — an exceptional feed supplement for poultry, fish, and livestock. Sustainably farmed and nutrient-dense.

name: Dried Maggot Meal
description: Sun-dried and processed maggot meal ideal for use as animal feed. Packed with protein, fats, and amino acids essential for livestock growth.
